subject.title: fix: before_agent_run transform no longer leaks redacted text into history

question: Should `before_agent_run` permanently support a `transform` outcome that rewrites both model-bound input and the canonical persisted user turn, with `block > transform > pass` precedence?
rationale: This adds a public plugin API outcome and intentionally changes canonical session history, observer visibility, and multi-plugin composition; source correctness cannot determine that permanent product contract.

options.title: Sponsor transcript-rewriting transform
options.body: Keep the proposed contract after replacing marker parsing with structured current-turn ownership and supplying full live proof across both runners.

options.title: Keep transforms model-local
options.body: Preserve the earlier model-only contract and explicitly document that plugins must block rather than transform when canonical transcript redaction is required.

options.title: Decline the new outcome
options.body: Keep `before_agent_run` limited to pass/block and require redaction products to use a separately designed input-normalization API.

recommendation.title: Sponsor transcript-rewriting transform
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed contract after replacing marker parsing with structured current-turn ownership and supplying full live proof across both runners.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository ownership plus recent adjacent agent/session runtime work makes this the best available owner for the public plugin and transcript semantics decision.
